hypothesis: A regularized linear head on frozen parent appearance adds division-propensity evidence distinct from daughter-pair geometry. A fixed equal rank blend may improve prospective high-precision recall without EXP171's flexible-MLP instability.

arms.blend: 0.5 raw percentile rank + 0.5 appearance percentile rank

threshold_protocol: Select one precision>=0.50 threshold per arm on calibration only, then apply it numerically unchanged to prospective. Prospective labels cannot select a threshold or model.
promotion_gate: Only the preregistered blend may advance, and only if its fixed threshold yields prospective precision>=0.50 and recall>=0.20.
